strata.mining_hazard_type: Trench wall slumping; acute gamma-emitter dust inhalation
strata.geologist_field_notes: Core is dark brownish-gray packed silt saturated with radioactive cesium and strontium fallout. Excavation here requires positive-pressure air hoods and heavy shoring box shields.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Loose boulder rollout; sudden sand and gravel washouts
strata.geologist_field_notes: Dense gravel bed containing smooth quartzite river cobbles up to 40cm across. Excellent thermal insulation for upper airlock vestibules, but terrible structural cohesion.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Roof delamination; moisture-induced slaking and swelling
strata.geologist_field_notes: Platy dark gray mudstone. When dry, holds a neat 2.5m ceiling. When exposed to humid ventilation exhaust, slakes into slippery clay within fourteen days. Lagging timbers mandatory.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Razor-sharp slab spalling along cleavage planes during blasting
strata.geologist_field_notes: The renowned Tessarat Blue Slate. Splices into perfect 10mm blackboard tablets and roof shingles. Sister Mara's memorial crypt is carved into this dense, ringing stone.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Spontaneous iron sulfide oxidation; acid mine drainage and SO2 gas
strata.geologist_field_notes: Striated with golden pyrite crystals. Smells of crushed sulfur when struck with a pick. Ilya assays this horizon for industrial sulfur extraction to recharge station batteries.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Extremely hard drilling; heavy tungsten-carbide bit wear
strata.geologist_field_notes: The primary structural vault of the bunker. A monolithic 18.5-meter block of dolomitic limestone with zero water seepage. Resists surface 500-kiloton blast overpressure with ease.

strata.strata_name: Karstic Vuggy Limestone with Calcite Vugs
strata.mining_hazard_type: Sudden breach into water-filled karst cavities; CO2 gas accumulation
strata.geologist_field_notes: Contains natural solution cavities lined with dog-tooth calcite crystals. Miners must drill pilot advance holes 3 meters ahead of the face to prevent drowning from pressurized water pockets.

strata.mining_hazard_type: High-pressure artesian water inrush (3.5 bar hydrostatic head)
strata.geologist_field_notes: The lifeblood of Tessarat Bunker. Pure 4.2°C sweet water protected from surface fallout by 50 meters of impermeable limestone cap. Tapped by Pump Room #4.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Heavy ore dust; abrasive wear on pneumatic crusher jaws
strata.geologist_field_notes: Dark reddish-brown ironstone composed of spherical ooids cemented by siderite. Supplies the raw iron charge for Master Oleg and the Silent Foundry blast cupola.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Combustible coal dust; methane gas (CH4) seepage pockets
strata.geologist_field_notes: A pristine 4.5-meter bed of lustrous vitreous anthracite. Burns with a smokeless blue flame at 7,800 kcal/kg. Continuous safety-lamp methane monitoring mandatory.

strata.strata_name: Dark Nodular Flint & Black Chert Band
strata.mining_hazard_type: Conchoidal razor fragments; extreme sparking when struck with pick
strata.geologist_field_notes: Solid nodules of jet-black flint up to 50cm diameter. Produces sharp conchoidal flakes that can cut leather gloves. Non-sparking copper-beryllium tools required.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Creep deformation under high lithostatic pressure; floor heave
strata.geologist_field_notes: Snow-white crystalline gypsum and dense bluish anhydrite. Mined and calcined into plaster of Paris for medical bone fracture casting and airtight corridor mortar.

strata.strata_name: Tessarat Main Boundary Thrust Fault Zone
strata.mining_hazard_type: Catastrophic roof collapse; major radon radon channel; active creep
strata.geologist_field_notes: The active seismic boundary of the valley. Heavily ground clay gouge slickensided with graphite. Do not excavate permanent residential vaults across this eight-meter belt.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Severe silicosis hazard; diamond drill bit polishing and glazing
strata.geologist_field_notes: Pure silica grains cemented with secondary quartz overgrowths. 99.2% SiO2. Mined as refractory foundry sand and raw glass batch for optical instrument making.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Prone to floor buckling and sudden sidewall squeezing
strata.geologist_field_notes: Deep dark green schist with silky graphite cleavage planes. The graphite flakes are scraped and mixed with grease to lubricate heavy turbine bearings and winch screws.

strata.rock_type: Deep Hard Block Anthracite with Vitrinite
strata.mining_hazard_type: Methane gas outbursts; elevated geothermal temperature (28°C)
strata.geologist_field_notes: Eight meters of solid anthracite at a ambient temperature of 28°C. This lower seam guarantees fuel reserves for the community boilers through the next twenty winters.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Slippery footing from soft talc powder; dust coating on electrical insulators
strata.geologist_field_notes: Dense crystalline magnesite (MgCO3). Carved into refractory crucible bricks for the foundry blast furnace. Talc dust provides dry thermal insulation for electrical conduit runs.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Severe rockburst hazard under high stress; impossible to drill with steel bits
strata.geologist_field_notes: A massive 28-meter dark greenish-black igneous dike. Hardest rock encountered in the bore. Serves as the indestructible anchor foundation for our deep blast bunkers.

strata.rock_type: Coarse Arkosic Sandstone with Hot Brine
strata.mining_hazard_type: Superheated steam and scalding water breakout (85°C at 12 bar pressure)
strata.geologist_field_notes: Hot saline aquifer at 85°C. When piped through heat exchangers on Sub-Level 5, warms the entire bunker residential complex without burning a single lump of coal.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Extreme radon gas buildup (48,000 Bq/m³); gamma radiation hot zone
strata.geologist_field_notes: Contains 0.12% natural uranium in organic matrix. Emits dangerous concentrations of radon-222 gas. Sealed behind two airtight steel bulkheads with dedicated negative-pressure blowers.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Magnetic interference destroying magnetic compasses and tube radios
strata.geologist_field_notes: Striking red jasper and black crystalline magnetite bands (55% Fe). Heavy magnetic signature causes compass needles to spin wildly. Mined for high-grade transformer core iron.

strata.strata_name: Permian Subterranean Halite Rock Salt Plug
strata.mining_hazard_type: Plastic salt creep; catastrophic dissolution if water pipes leak
strata.geologist_field_notes: An immense dome of crystal salt. Completely dry with zero radon emission. Carved into dry grain storage silos and long-term seed archives. Water is strictly forbidden in this tier.

strata.mining_hazard_type: Extreme rock hardness; micro-seismic popping sounds under deep stress
strata.geologist_field_notes: Ancient crystalline basement rock over 2.4 billion years old. Highly competent dark green hornblende amphibolite. No timbering required; drilled adits hold open indefinitely.

strata.mining_hazard_type: High geothermal ambient temperature (42°C); severe strain energy release
strata.geologist_field_notes: The bottom of the deepest research borehole. Dense, dry, crystalline granulite roots of the Eurasian craton. Ambient rock temperature is 42°C. Below us lies two billion years of unbroken stone. We are safe.
